protocol.recentReadBlocker: Recent-message structuredContent is an array; SDK 1.30.0 requires an object. A reviewed upstream fix/version or separately approved patch and compatibility rerun are required. Scoped search is not recent-history coverage.

whatsapp.evidenceScope: Disposable pinned-artifact/approved-patch checks and synthetic scoped-search protocol only; no installed, paired or callable runtime.

One installation-owned private persistent LocalAuth profile and linked session shared across personas
Supported host MCP integration and verified single-installation process/descendant lifecycle
Pinned CLI unregisters successful-start signal handlers; graceful CLI shutdown and process-tree settlement remain unverified
Separately authorized QR pairing and persistent reconnect without logout on sleep
Separate live selected-chat read/isolation and measured reconnect/history-gap coverage
Current account/platform terms review for unofficial WhatsApp Web automation
Browser resource, sleep and cost evidence
Complete transitive source/asset/license and required-notice review before redistribution
